contract.scope: ATP_MAIN calibration required by the one-game ALT/GAS flagged replay; no tuning or other-tour claim
contract.pool: Installed first-price weights, direction-matched member outcomes, FIRST then BASE; unchanged side/role, category, walk-forward and same-day exclusions
contract.target: At least one strictly later cutter-accepted positive-size print at or below translated L and strictly before member bell. No-hit member keeps its weight. No carried price or zero-size print counts.
contract.witness_limitation: Held cutter witness source has unknown block status, inherited and disclosed; this experiment does not claim verified non-block reach or known queue priority.
contract.calibration: Filed weighted isotonic PAV, category/side/receipt-time role/selected layer/atlas gate separately. One total weight per earlier called library game over all legal integer-cent levels below its current. Train only on games whose bell precedes the query formation, excluding self and event-name same day. No named/tune outcomes. No earlier rows means no permission.
contract.application: Piecewise-linear interpolation and explicit endpoint clipping as filed. At a receipt use the latest atlas gate already reached within the query span, never a future gate. Raw probabilities are recomputed at the actual receipt. No curve before the first available gate.
contract.validation: Walk-forward held-out library predictions, raw and calibrated probabilities versus realized reach by absolute L, depth below current and gate; raw-only versus common calibration coverage separate. Report Brier and endpoint clipping. No tuning from these results.
contract.decision: Legal market increments from band q25 inclusive to below current, maker-only and actual pair cap. Maximize calibrated P(reach before bell) times (riser close destination + faller floor destination - actual filled or licensed riser cost - L). Positive discount and positive expected discount required. Exact objective ties retain the standing feasible level, then lower cent, inheriting filed reach-map order.
contract.unchanged: Destinations, role call, learned faller window, fresh deadline requirement, riser entry, post-only, veto, actual commitment cap, same-second rejection, fill law and replay clock. Default flag off. No automatic installation.
contract.acceptance: Synthetic strict-witness, isotonic and argmax tests; source/temporal checks; actual OS replay twice; flag-off digest identical; face source equality and hosted verification. No result numbers prescribed.

contract.first_bind: observed pair receipt prefix; flips increment only on an observed directional reversal
contract.prediction_grid: subsequent fixed atlas gates only; independent of query future ticks
contract.q: query current last + weighted quantile(member remaining minimum - member current last)
contract.remaining_path: gate carried state plus native historical member changes through bell; earliest tied minimum
contract.x: independent weighted median(member remaining floor minutes-to-bell); query bell - X*60

source.witness_limitation: Cutter-accepted positive-size prints; inherited source has unknown block status, as disclosed in the filed reach-map run. No carried price, zero-size, same-time or at/after-bell witness.

raw.method: Actual OS helpers: unchanged first-price weights, direction-conditioned masks, FIRST then BASE; earlier-only and event-name same-day exclusion. All integer-cent levels below current; later positive witnesses only, no-hit members retain weight. Targets are library-only.

query_binding.source: Previously bound replay metadata; identity/date/formation only, no prices or outcomes
